# WebLens

> One command to read and search the web, for people and AI agents. `weblens read <url>` turns any public URL into clean text, routed to the best backend (Hacker News, Wikipedia, arXiv, Stack Overflow, YouTube transcripts, GitHub, RSS, Reddit, Twitter/X, V2EX, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, else Jina Reader). `weblens search <query>` searches the web (Exa) or one source. WebLens also installs (pinned versions) and health-checks the upstream tools behind each platform. Free, open source, MIT. PyPI package: `weblens`.

## Quick Start

- [README](https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USER/weblens/blob/main/README.md): Overview, commands, supported sources, agent setup, Python API, security
- [Installation Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USER/weblens/main/docs/install.md): Step-by-step setup written for AI agents (`pipx install weblens`, then `weblens install --env=auto`)
- [Update Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USER/weblens/main/docs/update.md): Upgrade WebLens and refresh pinned upstream tools

## Core Commands

- `weblens read '<url>' [--json] [--max-chars N]`: read any public URL as clean text with a metadata header; notes report fallbacks
- `weblens search '<query>' [--source/-s SOURCE] [--limit/-n N] [--json]`: sources `web` (default; Exa, falls back to hackernews + wikipedia), `hackernews`, `wikipedia`, `arxiv`, `stackoverflow`, `youtube`, `github`, `v2ex`, `reddit`, `twitter`, `all` (web + hackernews + wikipedia + stackoverflow + arxiv in parallel)
- `weblens doctor [--json]`: channel status and the active backend per platform
- `weblens install --env=auto [--system] [--dry-run] [--channels LIST]`: check-only by default; `--system` installs and configures
- `weblens configure <key>`, `weblens skill --install`, `weblens transcribe <url-or-file>`, `weblens watch`, `weblens check-update`, `weblens uninstall`
- Global flags: `--debug` (tracebacks), `-v`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 bad usage

## Sources

- Zero-config: any web page (Jina Reader), web search (Exa via mcporter, free), YouTube (yt-dlp), GitHub (gh or public API), Hacker News, Wikipedia, arXiv, Stack Overflow / Stack Exchange, RSS/Atom, V2EX
- Login or setup: Reddit (OpenCLI / rdt-cli), Twitter/X (twitter-cli / OpenCLI, Cookie-Editor cookies), LinkedIn (mcp-server-linkedin), Facebook and Instagram (OpenCLI, desktop Chrome session)
- China pack (optional): Bilibili (bili-cli), Xiaohongshu (OpenCLI / xiaohongshu-mcp), V2EX, Xueqiu, Xiaoyuzhou podcasts (Groq Whisper), BOSS Zhipin (boss-agent-cli over CDP)

## Integrations

- [Agent skill](https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USER/weblens/blob/main/weblens/skill/SKILL.md): `weblens skill --install` registers it for Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode and `~/.agents/skills`
- MCP server: `python -m weblens.integrations.mcp_server` (stdio; install with `pip install 'weblens[mcp]'`). Tools: `get_status`, `read(url, max_chars?, format?)`, `search(query, source?, limit?, format?)`
- Python API: `from weblens.core import WebLens; WebLens().read(url)`, `WebLens().search(query, source="arxiv")`

## Security

- `read` refuses localhost, private IPs and internal hostnames; Jina Reader and Exa see the URLs/queries sent to them
- Credentials stay in `~/.weblens/config.yaml` (mode 600), entered via hidden prompt or `--stdin`
- Upstream installs are pinned to exact versions or commits
- [Security policy](https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USER/weblens/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USER/weblens/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): YouTube 429, GitHub rate limit, Exa not configured, Stack Exchange quota, Twitter/X auth, BOSS Zhipin login
